key_insight: PIF-MIONet couples physics-informed fluid-flow predictions with FEM mechanical equilibrium through IFENN to model poroelasticity across varying inputs.
engineering_relevance: Integration with the open-source GEOS simulator offers a path toward accelerating complex, industrial-scale coupled poromechanics simulations.
method: Stagger FEM mechanical-equilibrium solves with neural fluid-flow predictions.
Fuse MIONet branch outputs to enable early interaction among input functions.
Use physics-and-data training and extend the architecture with domain decomposition for localized flow.
evidence_signal: Tests span 2D and 3D domains, variable material properties and time discretizations, and unseen loading histories; for complex cases, physics-and-data training used only 0.1% of the training increments used for pure data-driven training.
watch_item: Industrial-scale speedups and robustness of the staggered coupling are not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: Physics-Informed Fusion-MIONet with IFENN: A Generalized Framework for Coupled Poroelasticity Problems
